question.text: Let $f$ be a differentiable function satisfying $f(x)=1-2 x+\int_{0}^{x} \mathrm{e}^{(x-t)} f(t) \mathrm{dt}, x \in \mathbf{R}$ and let $\mathrm{g}(x)=\int_{0}^{x}(f(\mathrm{t})+2)^{15}(\mathrm{t}-4)^{6}(\mathrm{t}+12)^{17} \mathrm{dt}, x \in \mathbf{R}$. If p and q are respectively the points of local minima and local maxima of g, then the value of $|\mathrm{p}+\mathrm{q}|$ is equal to $\_\_\_\_$.
